about: Every model a Blender script builds (M10, E315; docs/design/blender-practice.md). The script is the source, the GLB it exports is committed, a .blend never is. Run a target from the repo root with `bash node_modules/@wildshard/sdk/scripts/blender/build.sh <target>`, check one against its committed GLB with `--check`. Fields: script (the Blender entry, run with --python-exit-code 1), args, pre (shell, before Blender), sources (every other file the target needs: node_modules/@wildshard/sdk/scripts/check-model-sources.mjs refuses a file under src/blender/ that no target names; the SDK's own Blender lib is named as $SDK/scripts/blender/lib/ in commands and node_modules/@wildshard/sdk/scripts/blender/lib/ in file lists), inputs (committed files it reads), external (files it reads that another repo owns: path there → that repo and why; read from that repo's checkout in $WILDSHARD_REPOS, else beside this repo), lock (Cycles work: take the model lock), build (files Blender must leave in $BUILD), meshopt / copy ([build file, repo file] pairs), post (shell, after the copies), outputs (the committed files it makes), feeds (the code that loads them), manual (not buildable here: why), check (the command --check runs for a manual target).

driftwood-isle/island.about: Driftwood's spawn cove: terrain tiles, ~60-72 prototypes, 16.7 k placements, Cycles AO + bounce lightmaps (DRIFTWOOD-REMASTER X2, E52)

external.src/static/assets/pine-hollow/models/dri: shard-pine-hollow: the CC0 palms and rocks build_island.py places live in that repo since the split

driftwood-isle/fp-arms.about: Driftwood's first-person castaway arms (E334, board 2 A / 3 A): the arms and both swords modelled round Nine Dragon's round-13 skeleton, which keeps its 16 clips; + 15 finger bones a hand, the swim clips and the skin (bake.mjs), then the rig gate (gate.mjs → gate.json). --preview also writes posed PLYs for preview.py
